title: Load test matching for 2,000+ Crestview students
text:
The matching service took 4 seconds with 200+ students at Westbrook. Crestview could have 10x that in the first week. We must not launch there until matching is under 1 second at 2,000 students.

*   Daniel to rerun the load test on the v0.4 matching service with fake Crestview data
*   If it's still slow, consider matching per department first
